title: Lead-life guide: complete matrix, chronology, resolutions and current contract procedure
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full guide content review; proposal, delegated resolution, dated execution and current procedure separated
reviews.disposition:
F1. This complete guide read covers sections 1–10, the field matrix, nine system chapters, the chronological run log, all seventeen contradiction rows, both drift rounds and the LSD165–256 index. The guide is navigation and scoped proposal/history beside LEAD_LIFE_RULES and current world/task owners. A mapped LSD code or linked checkpoint is not a fresh reading of that source, JSON, code or book. Its matrix does not claim coverage of later LSD257–470. Under AD32, the Oct28 CLR/SUI/RPT direction remains binding; the proposed pull resolver, field migrations, tiers and global joins do not acquire that status from proximity.

F2. Read the older system gaps through the later log: CR2 was subsequently applied, not left an unapplied patch; MR2–MR4 and the specified road-contest/crowd fixtures have scoped floor receipts. Those fixtures do not prove book-fight parity, natural household progression or a general rumor/relationship engine. The original all-systems four-join proposal does not make deferred pull and general beat rewind prerequisites for each current slice under AD43. AD51 and section 10 qualify older second-world prerequisites: design the selected shared seam from known mechanisms, and validate the reuse claim with a genuinely different world. A first consumer does not wait for a whole second campaign.

F3. Preserve the measurement failures as well as gains: 157 event cards raised reachability in the stated sample while playable share stayed unchanged; zero recorded lossy folds with no folds is not demonstrated retention. The 14-thread spot check was neither blind nor a full-paragraph audit; clustering scores and shared-word joins remain provisional. TG1 resumed with Terra, TG2 used the verified fresh Luna session, and actor agreement/false-flag results do not create source truth. Schema-1.5 rows being produced does not prove mapper consumption. Historical allowance windows, price estimates, writer reservations and unsent reader plans grant no current spending or dispatch authority.

F4. Section 7 preserves the delegated reachable-step resolution: cards or montage can count where CLR6 retains choices, means, time/order, participants/place, outcome and noticed information; beats receive deeper controls first. That is not permission for a lossy fold to count as playable. Per-world variation was accepted while the particular pull curve remained a proposal. CL21 causal mass and actual CL22 mechanisms qualify the stale universal canon-pressure default. OD24 concerns player obligation; AD44 concerns build order. Outcome tier is a canon-run default rather than an absolute. The unread-field decision was deferred, not authorization to delete retained useful data or buy another reread. Optional human play remains optional under AD42.

F5. Section 10 already supplies the operative consumer workflow: later-source-aware contracts, actual producer/command/settlement/return, attributed knowledge and source-era fences, qualified temporary means and lasting consequences, meaningful daily chains and patient-scoped longevity. Retain the distinction between historical chapter-only mixed-volume maps and qualified volume/chapter locators. Apply the current LOTM/Klein campaign and Harry developer route, desktop prose-first independent panes, optional art, AD52/ACR activity compression and the released Nov4 foundation ownership recorded in current owners. An earlier active KJ1 sentence, old coordinator order, low-budget reservation or old missing-mechanism list is not current runtime status. Long routines preserve real benefits and clocks without automatic enemy scaling, friendship decay or forced restart incentives. This reconciliation changes documentation only and does not renew any linked runtime, source-reading, packaging or installation proof.
reviews.evidence: Full 616-line input read in delivered ranges 1–100,101–155,156–225,226–315,316–405,406–485,486–616. Cross-owner authority uses previously inspected current owners; no fresh code, linked book, private data or browser verification.
reviews.reopen: Selected current consumer or changed accepted direction; qualify exact source/contract/proof gap without restarting historical paid reader lanes.
